rows.name: Champion of Anarchy
rows.description: You spread chaos wherever you go.

rows.name: Champion of Balance
rows.description: You are dedicated to perfect balance in the multiverse.

rows.name: Champion of Destruction
rows.description: You would destroy the world if it were within your power.

rows.name: Champion of Freedom
rows.description: You believe that beings can thrive only when free.

rows.name: Champion of Grace
rows.description: It is your mission to do as much good as possible.

rows.name: Champion of Malevolence
rows.description: Things would be better if everyone just did as you wished.

rows.name: Champion of Righteousness
rows.description: You know that good must be tempered with order if it's going to prevail in the long term.

rows.name: Champion of Tranquility
rows.description: The harmony of law is your highest ideal.

rows.name: Champion of Tyranny
rows.description: You must beat down the masses to have true order.

rows.name: Combat Stamina
rows.description: You stop at nothing to drive your attack home.

rows.name: Extra Stamina
rows.description: You can push yourself to higher limits.

rows.name: Push the Limits
rows.description: Even when suffering from fatigue, you can fight through and overcome incredible opposition.

rows.name: Critical Cure
rows.description: Your healing is more effective if your patient is badly injured.

rows.name: Endurance
rows.description: Harsh conditions or long exertions do not easily tire you.

rows.name: Twist the Knife
rows.description: You're especially dangerous against enemies who are suffering from injuries.

rows.name: Extra Unchained Rogue Talent
rows.description: Through constant practice, you have learned how to perform a special trick.

rows.name: Signature Skill
rows.description: Your ability with a particular skill is the stuff of legends, and you can do things with that skill that others cannot.
